title: ::: K-IG 교육 영어듣기훈련프로그램 | 기초2 | 제 001 회 강의 :::
label: [ K-IG 교육 Reading 117 ]

blocks.text: If you want to make a bookcase yourself, follow these simple steps. Make a plan for a bookcase that suits your own library. Then, choose wood materials for the bookcase from a wood materials store. When you have bought the wood, carefully cut it according to your design. The next step is to put the different parts together with glue and nails. After that, add the finishing touch by painting the woodwork. Now you have a fine piece of furniture.

readingSentences.english: If you want to make a bookcase yourself, follow these simple steps.
readingSentences.korean: 네 스스로 책장을 만들고 싶으면, 다음의 간단한 단계를 따르라.

readingSentences.english: Make a plan for a bookcase that suits your own library.
Then, choose wood materials for the bookcase from a wood materials store.
readingSentences.korean: 그런 다음, 목재상에서 책상용 나무를 골라라.

readingSentences.english: When you have bought the wood, carefully cut it according to your design.
readingSentences.korean: 목재를 산 후, 설계에 따라 조심스럽게 잘라라.

readingSentences.english: The next step is to put the different parts together with glue and nails.
readingSentences.korean: 다름 단계는 접착제와 못으로 여러 부분들을 조립하는 것이다.

readingSentences.english: After that, add the finishing touch by painting the woodwork.
readingSentences.korean: 그런 후, 목 작업물에 페인트칠을 함으로써 마지막 손질을 추가해라.

readingSentences.english: Now you have a fine piece of furniture.
readingSentences.korean: 자, 이제 멋진 가구 한 점을 갖게 됬다.
